faces.name: Bucket List
faces.oracleText:
Whenever you cast a spell of a type showing on Bucket List, put a counter over that type and draw a card. If all five types on Bucket List have counters over them, sacrifice it and draw one more card.

faces.name: Bucky Barnes, Eager Ally
faces.oracleText:
Vigilance
When Bucky Barnes dies, look at the top four cards of your library. You may reveal an Equipment, Hero, or Soldier card from among them and put it into your hand. Put the rest on the bottom of your library in a random order.
